text:
Aisha Rahman: Heads-up team — webinar in 6 days. Need final run-of-show, speaker confirmations, and lead-routing rules. Can we lock this today?
Tom Garcia: I'm good for slides and the benchmark section. Will post slide deck link by tomorrow.
Sanaa Ortiz: I'll join the panel and do a short customer-lighting segment. Can someone confirm demo owner?
Omar Bashir: Omar here — happy to co-run the demo with Sanaa. Suggest a short 6-minute demo plus a 90s recorded fallback clip.
Nina Gomez (ops): Ops note: I'll prepare a fallback video + alt stream endpoint and a static HTML page that can be shown if RTMP fails.
Tom Garcia: For demo content, propose: 1) cold-start performance; 2) cost / token breakdown; 3) generation + retrieval example. Keeps it digestible.
Sanaa Ortiz: Sounds good. For retrieval example can we show embeddings + rerank? 2-min snippet.
Aisha Rahman: Run-of-show draft: 00:00 - Welcome (Aisha)
03:30 - Benchmarks & unit economics (Tom)
09:30 - Demo (Omar + Sanaa)
17:30 - Customer panel + live Qs (Sanaa + others)
25:00 - CTA + trial offers + lead form (Aisha)
Tom Garcia: Add a 90s buffer after demo for possible reconnects. Also add a 30s talk-track for the recorded fallback clip.
Nina Gomez (ops): Streaming checklist: primary RTMP + backup to a second region, OBS scene with video asset, S3 URL for fallback, and keep stream key in 1Password. I'll post the exact commands in #eng-infra.
Omar Bashir: Demo checklist: pin to model v3.0-quant, use dedicated capacity key, run 5 warmup requests from staging 15 minutes before go.
Tom Garcia: Warmup script suggestion: `for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'; done`
Aisha Rahman: Lead routing: primary goes to HubSpot for marketing nurture; high-intent (enterprise, SLA, dedicated) to SFDC with owner assignment. Capture fields: company size, model interest, deployment preference.
Sanaa Ortiz: Can we tag anyone who asked demo requests as "demo-warm" so AE team can prioritize?
Aisha Rahman: Yes. Rule: if attendee selects "request a demo" or types keywords (dedicated/private/SLA) -> SFDC high-intent. Otherwise HubSpot.
WebinarBot: Calendar created: Dry run 1 (content) Tue 10:00 PT; Full dress run Thu 16:00 PT. Recording + automated transcript enabled. Invites sent.
Nina Gomez (ops): On dress run, I'll execute the failover test: cut primary RTMP and swap to backup, validate fallback video loads, and run the warmup script.
Tom Garcia: Action items: Tom - benchmarks slides by Tue EOD; Omar & Sanaa - demo script + recorded fallback clip; Nina - infra failover + OBS scene; Aisha - lead mapping doc + registration form fields.
Sanaa Ortiz: I'll also prepare two customer soundbites (30s each) for the panel intro slide. Need approval on copy by Wed noon.
Aisha Rahman: Great. If any blockers pop up ping me. Let's aim for concise rehearsals. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
